files.description: Standing operating rules for this repo: the one-way trust direction, credential boundaries, the deliberate IAM exceptions (DevEBS=true volumes, the nextjs-dev role) and the pitfalls behind them

Operator runbook: the rollout gates and their recorded prerequisites (security posture, backup cleanup and cutover, Colton Games Workers Builds, the Mac host) and the documented behaviour of the ndev and pbox helpers
